name: title
label: Title
description: Title of the activity stream compose

name: table
label: Table
description: Name of the record where the activity stream will be displayed

name: sysId
label: Sys ID
description: The alphanumeric combination used to identify the record

name: fields
label: Fields definition
description: Option to define more field options

name: isNewRecord
label: New record
description: Option to indicate that the record is new

name: useTabs
label: Use tabs
description: Option to display fields in tabs instead of a dropdown if space allows; not available in stacked mode

name: fixedHeight
label: Text input fixed height
description: When using the text input plainTextEditorHeightInRows controls how many rows are visible. When using rich text richTextEditorHeightInPixels controls height in px.

name: allowJournalFieldSettingsOverrides
label: Allow journal settings overrides
description: Overrides the fields definition property

name: journalFieldSettings
label: Journal settings
description: Specifies additional attributes for the fields referenced in the fields definition property

name: canPostMandatoryFields
label: Show post button for mandatory journal fields
description: Enables mandatory fields to be posted; not recommended for use in a form

name: isSideBySideViewAvailable
label: Is side by side view available
description: Option to make the side by side view available to users

name: isSideBySideViewEnabled
label: Is side by side view enabled
description: Enables the side by side view when selected

name: isRichTextEnabled
label: Enable rich text editor
description: Initially displays the rich text editor when selected

name: isRichTextAvailable
label: Show rich text editor toggle
description: Option to make the rich text editor available to users

name: insertValueInJournalField
label: Insert value in journal field
description: Insert value in journal field

name: isModelessDialogExperienceEnabled
label: Enable modeless dialog experience
description: This property determines if users have the option of popping out to a modeless dialog

name: showFieldLabels
label: Show field labels
description: Determines if the labels should be shown in compose

name: enableUnsavedFieldIndicators
label: Enable unsaved indicators
description: When enabled, shows an indicator for unsent emails and unsaved journal compositions

name: fitToParent
label: Fit to parent
description: Expands compose to full height of parent container. This requires a defined height on the parent

name: autoresize
label: Autoresize
description: Let the inputs grow and shrink its height with the text you enter. This field is ignored if Text input fixed height is set to a value

name: enableManualResizer
label: Enable manual resizer
description: Enables manual resizing of the inputs. When set to false the resize drag handle will not be visible regardless of any other internal logic.

name: bare
label: Bare
description: Optional configuration to remove padding around the activity stream compose component

name: emailAction
label: Email Action
description: Enables properties to control the display of the email composer

name: hasUnsentEmail
label: Has unsent email
description: Indicates the email in compose is an unsent email the user has started typing

name: showEmailMiniCompose
label: Show email mini compose
description: When to show email mini compose

name: emailMiniComposerPosition
label: Email mini composer position
description: Where should the option to compose a new email be placed when there is multiple options

name: supplemental
label: Supplemental
description: Supplemental data for activity stream events, such as flags, favorites, and pins

name: postButtonSize
label: Post button size
description: What size should the post buttons have

name: postButtonVariant
label: Post button variant
description: Post button style variant

name: landmark
label: Include in landmark keyboard shortcut
description: Landmarks define main elements on the page. When you set this property to true, the component will be included in the landmark keyboard shortcut cycling behavior, allowing users to quickly jump focus back-and-forth between the main elements on the page.

name: showTitle
label: Show compose title
description: Displays the compose title in the activity stream

name: suppressGlobalEvents
label: Suppress global events
description: Suppress events that rely on parent elements handling, and only dispatch events with the component prefix that are manually binded

name: userSession
label: User session information
description: Object containing the user session information

name: recordMembers
label: Record members
description: Members added to watch list, caller, assigned to or any other reference type field in forms are visible for @mentions in watch list

name: nowDsDomainId
label: Domain Id
description: Id of the domain of the record

name: nowDsDomainScope
label: Domain Scope
description: Domain scope through which the record is being viewed

name: nowDsRecordId
label: Domain Record Id
description: Id of record in the domain

name: nowDsRecordTable
label: Domain Record Table
description: Table of the record in the domain

name: dialogList
label: Dialog list
description: List of dialog information provided by the modeless dialog controller. This let the component know when dialogs are opened, closed or minimized.

name: lastFormSubmit
label: Last form submit
description: Timestamp of the last time the form has be submitted / saved. Value will be 0 if user has not saved since the page was loaded.

name: showHelpTextAndPresence
description: Controls whether to show help text and user presence below the compose area.

name: showPresence
label: Show presence
description: When true (default), renders the user-presence (is typing) indicator beneath the compose area.

name: showPostButton
description: Controls whether to show the post button in the compose area.

name: emailValidationStatus
label: Email validation status
description: Object that controls whether email can be sent after validation. Contains value (boolean) and timestamp
